description: This Java class 'SettingsTab' provides a user interface component for managing configuration dialogs within an application. It includes methods for displaying dialogs, handling user interactions, and dynamically generating UI controls based on configuration fields.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A UI component class for displaying and managing configuration dialogs within the application.

methods.name: SettingsTab
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI component and shows a loading message.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Returns the main content component for embedding in the UI.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Displays the dialog selection UI, handles user interactions, and dynamically generates configuration controls.

methods.name: selectDialog
methods.description: Populates the dialog body with controls based on the selected dialog's fields.
